'''Infrablue Zedbeddy Coggins''' was a [[Gender|male]], [[Color|brown]]-skinned<ref name="TFAVD" /> [[Zenezian]]<ref name="CYD Maz" /> [[musician]] who played the [[hypolliope horn cluster]]. Around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], Coggins played at the [[Takodana Castle|castle]] of the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]] as part of the [[band]] [[Shag Kava]]<ref name="TFA" /> alongside [[Taybin Ralorsa]], [[Ubert Quaril]], and [[Sudswater Dillifay Glon]].<ref name="TFAVD" /> While the four performed, Kanata spotted the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] entering the establishment, and yelled to him, causing the [[band]] to fall silent. They then resumed their playing, but were soon disturbed again when many of the castle's residents rushed out to witness the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[Hosnian system]] by the [[First Order]]'s [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]]. The castle was then [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] and destroyed by the [[First Order military|forces]] of the [[First Order]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Infrablue Zedbeddy Coggins was created for [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], which was released in [[2015]]. The alien was not identified in the film, but received a name in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released the same day as the film.<ref name="TFA" /> Coggins was played by [[Kiran Shah]],<ref name="Coggins">{{WebCite|url=https://www.littlekiran.com/wordpress/star-wars|text=Star Wars|archivedate=20240907104954}}</ref> who also played [[Pru Sweevant]]<ref name="TFAart">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref> and [[Teedo (Niima Outpost)|Teedo]].<ref name="TFA" />
